title: Failure Rate in Spinal Blocks and Determination of Related Factors
brief_summary: Investigators aimed to determine the rates of unsuccessful spinal anesthesia, to determine the factors related to failure and to determine the measures that may be taken to reduce this problem.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

1. Patients aged ≥ 18 years who are undergoing spinal anesthesia in Izmir Bozyaka Training and Research Hospital during study period.
2. American Society of Anesthesiologist Physical Status classification (ASA) I-IV.

Exclusion Criteria:

1\. Patients who are undergoing combined spinal-epidural anesthesia.
study_population: All patients aged ≥ 18 years undergoing spinal anesthesia in the Izmir Bozyaka Training and Research Hospital Operating Room will be included in the study.
